privacy: Your data stays on the center's server and is not shared with anyone.

login.title: Access your file
login.subtitle: Use your file number, phone number, and the code printed on your receipt.
login.fileNoHint: Printed on your receipt, for example PT-2026-000123
login.phoneHint: The number registered in your file
login.codeHint: The 8-digit code printed on your latest receipt
login.expired: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
login.help: No code? Ask the cashier to print it on your receipt.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.description: Your upcoming and past visits with the doctors.
appointments.cancelDescription: The time will be offered to other patients.
appointments.tooLate: It is too late to cancel online. Please call the center.
appointments.rules: You can hold up to {{max, bidi}} upcoming appointments and book up to {{days, bidi}} days ahead.

book.title: Book an appointment
book.description: Choose a doctor, a day and a free time.
book.noDoctors: No doctor takes online bookings at the moment.
book.chooseDoctorFirst: Choose a doctor to see the free days.
book.noDays: This doctor has no free time in the coming days.
book.chooseDayFirst: Choose a day to see the free times.
book.noSlots: No free time left on this day.

results.title: Lab results
results.description: Results appear here once the lab supervisor approves them.
results.noneHint: Results under work stay hidden until they are approved.
results.amendedNote: This result was corrected by the lab. It replaces the earlier version.
results.disclaimer: Discuss your results with your doctor.

prescriptions.title: Medicines and instructions
prescriptions.description: How to take what your doctor prescribed.
prescriptions.labHint: Preparation for tests that are still to be done.

bills.title: Bills and receipts
bills.description: Your share of each invoice and what you paid.

verify.title: Check a receipt
verify.description: Confirm that a receipt was issued by the center.
verify.receiptHint: Printed at the top of the receipt

statusHint.valid: This receipt matches the center's records.
statusHint.pending: The center recorded this transfer and is waiting for the bank to confirm it.
statusHint.void: This receipt is no longer valid. Please contact the center.

verify.notFound: This receipt could not be verified
verify.notFoundHint: Check the receipt number, or scan the QR code on the receipt again.
verify.rateLimited: Too many checks. Please try again in a few minutes.

code.title: Patient portal access
code.description: Print a code so the patient can see results and appointments on their phone.
code.howTo: Open {{url, bidi}} on your phone and sign in with your file number, your phone number and this code.
code.issued: A new portal code was issued. Earlier codes no longer work.

staff.title: Patient portal access
staff.none: No code is active. Print a slip so the patient can sign in to the portal.
staff.noPhone: Add a phone number to the file first: the patient signs in with it.
staff.revokeDescription: The code stops working at once and anyone signed in with it is signed out. Say why, for example a lost slip.
staff.slipDescription: Issue a code and print it for the patient. The code is shown only once.
staff.replaceWarning: This file already has an active code. A new code ends it and signs out anyone using it.
